name: BT International Navigator
description: Unofficial explorer for how BT International products relate to each other and to Cisco.
disclaimer: Unofficial demo summarized from public pages on international.bt.com and cisco.com. Not affiliated with BT Group or Cisco.

pillars.name: Secure Connectivity
pillars.desc: Global Fabric, dedicated internet, SD-WAN, and SASE as one connectivity story.
pillars.story: Offices, clouds, and users share one network. Access, SD-WAN, and SSE sit on Global Fabric instead of as separate estates.

pillars.name: Voice, Collaboration & CX
pillars.desc: Global Voice, Webex, and UC Edge — calling, meetings, and the voice layer under them.
pillars.story: Calling, meetings, and contact sit on Global Voice. Webex is one of the collaboration stacks that layer rides.

pillars.name: Managed Services
pillars.desc: Ops Fabric — observability, automation, and the operating wrap across network, voice, and security.
pillars.story: The platforms only hold if someone runs them. Ops Fabric is the operating model across connectivity, voice, and security.
